name: 1.0.0-beta.9
body:
### System improvements:
- Improve interaction between the app and cloud server.
- Clean up some of unused resources.
- Fix the blank page caused from the app itself.
- Handler to reject all pending requests from previous state.

name: 1.0.0-beta.8
body:
#### System improvements:
* Bugfix language doesn't save to local storage.
* Clean up some sources.

#### New features:
* Now Graph is available with line chart of this and last week on Dashboard.

name: 1.0.0-beta.4
body:
#### System Improvements:
- Using production server
- DB has been migrated to production server (30 Dec, 2017)
- Unlimited bandwidth, Unlimited Database Storage and Fast 24/7!
- **DANGER!** Please update at least to this version or above, if you don't want to lose your data! Beta server has limited database, if the data more than 200mb it will reset all of them.
